## **Vanilla and Forever boss mods for DBM**

Vanilla WoW and Forever mods for [Deadly Boss Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods)

## **Features**

Boss mods for all Vanilla raids (including those added in Season of Discovery and Forever)

Supports both Retail and Classic

## **Looking for Dungeons?**

Dungeon mods are now all grouped together in [DBM-Dungeons package](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-dbm-dungeons)

## **Looking for other Raid mods?**

You can find them at these links:

[Battle for Azeroth Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-dbm-bfa)

[Shadowlands Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-dbm-shadowlands)

[Legion Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-dbm-legion)

[Warlords of Draenor Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-wod)

[Mists of Pandaria Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-mop)

[Cataclysm Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-cataclysm-mods)

[Wrath of the Lich King Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-wotlk)

[Burning Crusade Raid Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods-tbc)

## **Important**

Please make sure you have the latest version of [Deadly Boss Mods](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/deadly-boss-mods) when updating the old content mods. This is a required dependancy
